editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Microsoft certification exam by planning, designing, and deploying AI-powered business solutions using official resources.
editorial.overview: The official certification program evaluates solution architects on planning, designing, and deploying AI-powered business solutions across modern enterprise platforms. Candidates prove thorough expertise in managing autonomous agents, enterprise copilots, advanced data grounding techniques, and cross-platform artificial intelligence workloads to support vital business operations and digital transformation objectives in modern environments.
editorial.who_should_take: Accomplished solution architects, technical leaders, and senior consultants with extensive hands-on experience designing secure, scalable, and integrated AI-driven business solutions using advanced Microsoft services and tools.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official exam guide and complete extensive hands-on practice sessions. Study grounding data requirements, multi-agent orchestration, agent monitoring tools, and application lifecycle management strategies in detail. Gain practical, working experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry tools before sitting for the examination.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers planning AI-powered business solutions by assessing agents in task automation and data analytics, reviewing data for grounding, and organizing business solution data for other artificial intelligence systems.
study_focus: Assess agents in task automation, data analytics, and decision-making
Review data for grounding, including accuracy, relevance, timeliness, cleanliness, and availability
Organize business solution data to be available for other AI systems

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses heavily on designing AI-powered business solutions by establishing business terms for Copilot in Dynamics 365 apps, designing app customizations, and building effective connectors for Dynamics 365 Sales.
study_focus: Design business terms for Copilot in Dynamics 365 apps for customer experience and service
Design customizations of Copilot in Dynamics 365 apps for customer experience and service
Design connectors for Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales

domain_guidance.summary: This domain involves deploying AI-powered business solutions through recommending tools for monitoring agents, analyzing user feedback and backlogs, and applying artificial intelligence tools to identify issues and perform system tuning.
study_focus: Recommend the process and tools required for monitoring agents
Analyze backlog and user feedback of AI and agent usage
Apply AI-based tools to analyze and identify issues and perform tuning

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive prepared to complete the proctored exam. Register using a personal account so exam records remain secure, and check with Microsoft for the exact price based on your region.

faq.answer_text: Candidates must achieve a minimum score of 700 to successfully pass the examination on a scaling system ranging from 1 to 1000 for all test takers.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The exact pricing is determined directly by the specific country or region in which the exam is proctored, as Microsoft does not publish a standard global list price.
Yes, it is currently active. You should always check directly with Microsoft for the latest updates regarding certification paths and long-term requirements before scheduling your test.

faq.question_title: What are the domain weights for the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam features three domains: planning AI-powered business solutions weighted at 27.5 percent, designing them weighted at 27.5 percent, and deploying them weighted at 42.5 percent.

methodology.summary: This thorough information page was carefully built using official Microsoft exam guides, study guides, and technical course outlines to ensure accurate information.
